pages.text: The $(item)Interstellar Scoop$() gathers what lies between the stars - but only where the air will not swamp it: at y 200 or above in the Overworld, or anywhere in the Accretion Frontier or the End. It gathers $(fluid)Molecular Cloud$() gas, $(fluid)Interstellar Medium$() (into glass bottles) and $(item)Interstellar Dust$() (onto paper).

A hot star ionises the gas round it out to a sphere where recombination keeps up: $(thing)Q = (4/3)πR³n²α$(). Photograph a dying star's shell with dust and a plate: a $(item)Planetary Nebula Shell$(). Four dust and a bucket of water make clay again - every rocky planet began as dust.
